info.name: Ashadi Jewellers - Workshop Floor REST API
info.description: Complete REST API collection to integrate external ERP, Showroom POS, Stock & Accounting systems with Ashadi Jewellers Goldsmith Workshop Floor.

request.description: Dispatches an external client or showroom order directly to a specific workshop craftsman bench.

request.description: Dispatches a multi-item bridal suite order with automatic combined SMT calculation.

item.name: Get All Workshop Allocations (Filter by Date / Status)

request.description: Returns current list of workshop jobs with status, craftsman details, hours, and gold weights.

item.name: Update Order Completion & Gold Return (Vault Checkin)

request.description: Called when craftsman returns the finished item and scrap gold to vault. System automatically computes scrap loss %.
Lists all 63 workshop bench craftsmen with skill tiers, minute rates, and bench numbers.
Lists design codes with standard operation times (SMT), metal types, and scrap ceilings.
Lists external B2B clients including Pushpa Jewellers, Swarna Jewellers, agreed scrap loss %, and contacts.

item.name: Get Daily 13-Hour Shift Audit & Capacity Waterfall

request.description: Returns gross on-site hours (819h), deducted breaks, productive standard output, capacity gap, and root-cause breakdown.
